designNotes: Decision table: approval on/off x submitter vs other approver.
State: pending -> approved (takes effect) / rejected (no effect).

cases.title: A contract has no effect until approved

steps.action: Try to book a session on it
steps.expected: The booking is refused while the contract is pending

cases.title: The submitter cannot approve their own request

steps.action: As Fitness Manager, submit an exception-price contract and open its approval request
steps.expected: The approve action is refused for the submitter

cases.title: Admin switches approval off for an action type

steps.action: As Admin, switch off approval for receipts
steps.expected: The approval matrix shows receipts as not requiring approval
The receipt is valid at once, with no approval request created

testConditions: approval off -> takes effect at once
